units.source_text: 河水下降了，却不见垂钓人的影子。

en.t: The river water had fallen, but there was no sign of the anglers.

units.source_text: 她们聚在测量技师的房间里游戏作乐。

en.t: They gathered in the surveyor's room, playing games and making merry.

units.source_text: 江湖画师在没有住客的房间的隔扇上作起画来。

en.t: The itinerant painter began painting on the sliding screens of a room with no guests.
